messages:
maya: quick check — vendor emailed: possible extra A100 slots in us-west1 but need 48h lead. can we take 3 for the demo pool next week? also i'm about to open a small PR to adjust `alloc-service` backoff. cc @eva as code-owner.

jon: vendor said raw quote: "we can reserve 3 units, ETA 48-72h, will invoice after shipment". i asked for firm ETA by EOD.

ash: how many free tenant slots do we have now? don't want to oversubscribe and break the demo.

jon: running quick probe: `./scripts/check_slots.sh --region=us-west1 --sku=A100`
output:
```
available_pools: demo=2, default=5
pending_reservations: 0
```
so 2 immediately available in demo pool.

maya: okay — vendor can hold 3 but we only have 2 warm. can we borrow 1 from default for the window?

rafa: i can spare 1 from default but need to adjust terraform to avoid cross-tenant churn. i'll open a tiny TF PR and tag owners.

maya: perfect — please include a note for finance about invoice code `RED-ALLOC-2026` so Lisa can tag it.

lisa: noted. when PR lands include estimated monthly run hours and market rate so we can pre-approve.

rafa: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4287 (WIP). includes `module/demo-pool` change + one-time borrow. cc: @ash @eva

deploy-bot: CI check: `alloc-service` unit tests failed on branch rafa/borrow - see logs: https://ci.redwood/4287/logs

eva: looking. most likely the borrow path isn't covered by tests. can you add a test around `rebalance_borrow()`? small one should be fine.

rafa: will add `tests/test_slot_rebalance.py` with mock provider, then re-run.

ash: once PR passes, can someone run `./scripts/claim_slot.sh --region=us-west1 --sku=A100 --count=1` and tag me so i can validate the demo job?

jon: happy to run it when CI passes. also asked vendor to confirm final ETA.

maya: thanks all — plan: rafa adds test, CI green, jon claims slot, maya schedules demo. if vendor ETA slips i'll fallback to borrowing 2 from default and flag the demo to use reduced batch size. :thumbsup:

eva: ack. i'll review TF + test once pushed. :eyes:
